description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called 'CronJobEditor' used for creating and editing cron jobs within the OpenClaw application. It includes interface elements for schedule configuration, payload details, and channel selections.

classes.name: CronJobEditor
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for editing or creating cron jobs, with properties for job configuration, schedule, payload, and related UI state.

methods.name: channelLabel
methods.description: Returns a display label for a given channel ID, resolving custom labels via ChannelsStore.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The SwiftUI view hierarchy for the CronJobEditor interface.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's fields based on the existing job data when editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the new or edited cron job, including validation and invocation of onSave callback.
